musicunbound.tooltip.netherKeepsMusic: Own: the Nether keeps its vanilla music. Shared: your playlist plays here too.
musicunbound.tooltip.endKeepsMusic: Own: the End keeps its vanilla music. Shared: your playlist plays here too.
musicunbound.tooltip.deepDarkKeepsMusic: Own: the Deep Dark keeps its vanilla music. Shared: your playlist plays here too.
musicunbound.tooltip.underwaterKeepsMusi: Own: underwater keeps its vanilla music. Shared: your playlist plays here too.
musicunbound.tooltip.playlist: The songs that play. Built-in playlists can be copied and edited.
musicunbound.tooltip.places: Where the vanilla music is kept or shared, and when a song starts by itself.
musicunbound.tooltip.extras: Toast, pause behaviour, fades and downloads.
musicunbound.tooltip.frequency.frequent: Wait at most 10 minutes between songs.
musicunbound.tooltip.frequency.constant: A new song starts 5 seconds after the last one.
musicunbound.tooltip.frequency.era: Use the gaps between songs of the playlist's Minecraft version.
musicunbound.tooltip.frequency.custom: Wait between the custom minimum and maximum below.
musicunbound.tooltip.eventDimension: When you arrive in another dimension, a song starts right away if nothing is playing.
musicunbound.tooltip.eventTime: At sunrise and nightfall, a song starts right away if nothing is playing.
musicunbound.tooltip.eventWeather: When a thunderstorm starts, a song starts right away if nothing is playing.
musicunbound.tooltip.eventCooldown: The shortest time between two event songs. All three events share it.
musicunbound.tooltip.showToast: Show a Now Playing box when a new song starts.
musicunbound.tooltip.playWhilePaused: Keep the music playing while the game is paused.
musicunbound.tooltip.showInPauseMenu: Show the current song in the pause menu.
musicunbound.tooltip.downloadNewTracks: Download the songs added after Minecraft 1.21.1 from Mojang's servers, once (about 33 MB).
musicunbound.tooltip.smoothFades: Fade the music out instead of cutting it when the music changes or you skip a song.
musicunbound.tooltip.jukeboxFade: Lower the background music while a jukebox plays nearby.
musicunbound.tracks.favourite: Favourites are picked twice as often as other songs.
musicunbound.tracks.gameUnavailable: This song can't play during the game.
musicunbound.playlist.none: None yet. Press New to make one.
musicunbound.playlist.deleteMessage: "%s" will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
musicunbound.playlist.tip.use: Play this playlist from now on.
musicunbound.playlist.tip.edit: Choose the songs in this playlist.
musicunbound.playlist.tip.new: Make a copy of the selected playlist and edit it.
musicunbound.playlist.tip.duplicate: Make an editable copy of this built-in playlist and switch to it.
